title: RichTextLabel: Vertically flowing over other elements when Selection enabled and a Highlight has been made.
body:
### Tested versions

 v4.5.1.stable.official [f62fdbde1]
Reproducible in v 4.4.x

### System information

Godot v4.5.1.stable - Pop!_OS 24.04 LTS on Wayland - Wayland display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - AMD Radeon 890M Graphics (radeonsi, gfx1150, LLVM 19.1.1, DRM 3.64, 6.17.7-1-liquorix-amd64) - AMD Ryzen AI 9 365 w/ Radeon 880M (20 threads) - 22.59 GiB memory

### Issue description

Using RichTextLabel with BBCode Enabled if you have Text Selection enabled. Once you have selected text and then scroll. The Container (not the text) will extend beyond its borders. This happens  when you have the RichTextLabel as a child of a Scrollbox container. 
Example:
\- VBoxContainer
-- ScrollBoxContainer
---- VboxContainer
------RichTextLabel

[Youtube Video](https://youtu.be/gVIkoNbeygs)

### Steps to reproduce

Create A project with a RichTextlabel nested a ScrollBox container. 

PannelContainer
-- VboxContainer
---- ScrollBoxContainer
------VboxContainer
--------RichTextLabel

In the Label add any amount of text you want and turn on selection. Highlight some text and then scroll. 

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[nestedrichtextlabelbug_2025-11-13_16-48-33.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/23535983/nestedrichtextlabelbug_2025-11-13_16-48-33.zip)
